1.explanation: The code sets up a basic dropdown using the Carbon Design System's Dropdown component. The items array contains several options. The issue can be reproduced by running this code on a Mac with VoiceOver enabled (Command + F5) and navigating through the dropdown items using the keyboard. VoiceOver will read each item twice, demonstrating the bug.
1.bug_scenario: The bug scenario involves a dropdown component where VoiceOver on Mac reads each dropdown item twice when navigating through the items using the keyboard. This occurs in Safari on macOS 11.1 with the latest version of the Carbon Design System.
